faq.title: imghancer FAQs
faq.description: Get quick answers to the most common questions about imghancer.

items.question: How do I enhance a photo with imghancer?
items.answer: Upload an image, choose the tool you need, preview the before/after, then download the result.

items.question: Can imghancer fix blurry or low-resolution photos?
items.answer: Yes. The enhance tool sharpens edges and restores detail while keeping textures natural.

items.question: Can I remove backgrounds or restore old photos?
items.answer: Yes. Background removal and photo restore are separate tools designed for those tasks.

items.question: What image types do you support?
items.answer: Common formats like JPG, PNG, and WEBP are supported.

items.question: Is imghancer free to use?
items.answer: You can try it for free, with upgrades available for higher limits and faster processing.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No. imghancer runs in the browser, so you can start immediately.
